up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows that have pChEMBL values, specifically for the human single-protein target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3070 (Intercellular adhesion molecule 1). Return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID followed by assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH target_activities AS ( SELECT a.activity_id, a.assay_id, a.molregno, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a WHERE a.assay_id IN ( SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE tid = (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3070') ) AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.molregno, a.assay_id LIMIT 1000 ) SELECT ta.assay_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, ta.standard_type, ta.pchembl_value FROM target_activities ta JOIN assays ass ON ta.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON ta.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON ta.molregno = cs.molregno ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id;
